changelog:
Initial release of the "yiyan-hot-trend" skill for Baidu Wenxin Yiyan public information summarization.

- Supports retrieval and summarization of information from Baidu Wenxin Yiyan product and documentation pages.
- Extracts key data such as model capabilities, pricing, quotas, and documentation links from publicly available sources.
- Focuses on lightweight, public content organization only—does not perform account operations or API calls.
- Handles dynamic page loading and respects platform access limits.
- Includes clearly defined data fields and sample usage flows for typical summarization tasks.
